title: Viva Insights: new Overview page in the Agent Dashboard

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard in Viva Insights has a new Overview page.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard control is reached through Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. ... On the Feature access management page, select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.
claims.fix: Complete the path as 'Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Feature access management > Agent Dashboard > Add policy'. The printed route reaches the correct feature but stops before Add policy and omits the page heading.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AgentDashboard -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates the tenant policy disabling the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -FeatureId <String> -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean> -ModuleId <String> -Name <String> ... [-Everyone]
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchange/add-vivamodulefeaturepolicy to sources. Its syntax and parameter definitions verify the call, while the already-cited manage-settings page supplies VivaInsights, AgentDashboard, false and Everyone for this operation. Keep the call unchanged.

claims.claim: The Viva Insights web app control can be configured through Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote: From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select Viva from the settings menu. Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. Select Create a policy.
claims.fix: Complete the route as 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Viva Insights > Viva Insights web app > Access setting > Off'. Keep the note about selecting the app and feature. The printed path reaches the policy page but omits the settings-menu heading and stops before the documented setting.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates the tenant policy disabling the web app.
claims.quote: The Everyone switch specifies that the policy applies to all users in the organization. ... $false: The feature is not enabled by the policy.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchange/add-vivamodulefeaturepolicy to sources. The reference verifies the parameters and values; the already-cited manage-settings page supplies the Viva Insights web app feature identifier. Keep the call unchanged.
